text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes. As a thank-you for running 
alongside me, please...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
No need. I only ran alongside you for my 
own sake.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Even so...! S-Still... it made me happy...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I... have no real presence... so I haven't 
had many chances to be invited to run 
together...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Umm, well...! Th-This chocolate is really 
delicious.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Sweet, melting chocolate, fragrant 
caramel... and the apple jam brings out 
the sweetness even more—

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Things that are too sweet sometimes invite 
corruption. I have no need for them.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"Is... that so? Then, let me at least 
offer my gratitude... Thank you so very 
much for today."

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(...Melty chocolate, fragrant caramel, 
apple jam... Chocolate... truly is the 
devil's food.)
